answer: Deposits are visible in opal, and jade reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 47 aliases, and each one needs its own funded hollow account. A bond of 54% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 1851 identities would post 3683 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
